newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: HLG Capital to sell Manila brokerage.
newsitem.headline: HLG Capital to sell Manila brokerage.

text.p: The Philippine's Unicapital Securities Inc had bought for 74 million pesos the seat of Malaysia's HLG Capital Berhad at the Philippine Stock Exchange Inc, an official of the exchange told Reuters on Thursday.
"The exchange was informed of the deal by Unicapital," said Elizabeth Dinoy, head of the membership department of the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Dinoy said Unicapital and HLG Capital are set to sign the "deed of sale" on April 15.
Unicapital Securities is owned by investment house Unicapital Inc, which is 51 percent owned by local holding firm Majalco Inc and 49 percent by Philippine broadcasting firm GMA Network Inc.

Earlier, the board of the Philippine Stock Exchange had approved the applications of Barclays de Zoete Wedd and Securities 2000, a unit of state-owned Singapore Technologies Inc, to operate seats in the bourse, other officials of the exchange said.
Barclays bought its seat in the local stock exchange from Jardine Fleming Phils Inc while Securities 2000 bought its seat from another local broker.
Last month, a unit of Swiss Banking Corp and UOB Securities of Singapore started operations in the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Of 184 broker seats in Manila, 40 are held by foreign firms.
The 40 include three that are yet to start operations. They are owned by Singapore's Paragon Securities and Nikko Securities and Nomura Securities, both of Japan, bourse officials said.
